notes.title: Binary Update 0.5.0 release note
notes.notes:
Welcome to update 0.5.0 of Binary.

The changes in the update are as follows

# Game balance update

* Game difficulty has been adjusted. Combat density has been increased and frequency has been decreased.


# Game action update

* Pressing the jump button during a glitch scythe attack now performs a cancel dash.
* Weapons can now be assigned from the ability installer.
* You can now set arts for each weapon.


That's all for the update. Enjoy!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706675/57490fb8d4cd821d6a78a0de6060b30d235a0836.png

* Adding a counter attack to the Critical Counter-Evade with a gun for a total attack.
  * Shooting a gun after a successful Critical Counter-Evade can unleash a powerful total attack.
* Fixed Enemy AI
  * Enemies now attack more aggressively!
* Fixed camera work
* Pathfinder screen now has retry and abort options!

notes.title: About the content of the first update of the Binary.
notes.notes:
The results of the voting are in. Thank you all for your cooperation.
There were 12 votes for the QoL update and 14 votes for the addition of actions, so we will focus on these areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706675/4b104c696c9df03589e5820a2265d37271bb5777.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706675/cd9a5dbd2ef5e41899cf80f5c4b10b651c7c840c.png


I will talk about what I am thinking about in terms of specific features to be updated next time.
However, the things I will talk about here are just plans, and there is no guarantee that they will come to fruition.
Also, you will not be able to play these features in the demo version, so if you want to participate in Early Access, please consider purchasing the game.

Here is what we plan to update.

Control and QoL improvements updates.

 Additional camera work options, including 3D sickness prevention
 Additional window resolution presets
 Toggle lock-on (but may be eliminated if there are operability issues after trying it out).


New Weapons and Actions updates.

 Addition of several existing weapon arts
 Backstab blink can be equipped directly on the command panel
 Adding a blink that drops directly down
 One new weapon and additional arts using it
 "Extension Trigger" (New Action)


Etc updates.

 Adding Training mode.
 UI updates.



We are planning for about 1~2 months of development, but we will not update everything at once, and depending on the content, we may release updates along the way.

notes.title: Developing next version of Binary.
notes.notes:
We have started Early Access and had a day to rest and see how it goes.
Thank you so much to those who have already purchased, those who were curious and DL'd the trial version, and those who talked about it. We were simply happy.

I would like to talk about the future development of Binary.

The developers have a lot of ideas to make the game cool and interesting, such as new actions and enemies that we are warming up to, but as you can see in the Early Access section of the Steam page, we want to reflect your feedback in the game.

If you've played the Demo version or Early Access, please let us know what you think on our forums or dedicated Discord server.
